name: lambda-microvms
description: Provides APIs to create, manage, and operate AWS Lambda MicroVMs and their associated MicroVM Image environments.

subcommands.name: create-microvm-auth-token
subcommands.description: Creates an authentication token for accessing a running MicroVM.

subcommands.name: create-microvm-image
subcommands.description: Creates a MicroVM image from the specified code artifact and base image.

subcommands.name: create-microvm-shell-auth-token
subcommands.description: Creates a shell authentication token for interactive shell access to a running MicroVM.

subcommands.name: delete-microvm-image
subcommands.description: Deletes a MicroVM image.

subcommands.name: delete-microvm-image-version
subcommands.description: Deletes a specific version of a MicroVM image.

subcommands.name: get-microvm
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a specific MicroVM, including its state, endpoint, image information, and configuration.

subcommands.name: get-microvm-image
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a MicroVM image, including its state, versions, and configuration.

subcommands.name: get-microvm-image-build
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a specific MicroVM image build, including its state, target architecture, and snapshot information.

subcommands.name: get-microvm-image-version
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a specific version of a MicroVM image, including its configuration, state, and build information.

subcommands.name: list-managed-microvm-image-versions
subcommands.description: Lists versions of a managed MicroVM image.

subcommands.name: list-managed-microvm-images
subcommands.description: Lists AWS managed MicroVM images available for use as base images.

subcommands.name: list-microvm-image-builds
subcommands.description: Lists builds for a MicroVM image version with optional filtering by architecture and chipset.

subcommands.name: list-microvm-image-versions
subcommands.description: Lists versions of a MicroVM image.

subcommands.name: list-microvm-images
subcommands.description: Lists MicroVM images in the account with optional name filtering.

subcommands.name: list-microvms
subcommands.description: Lists MicroVMs in the account with optional filtering by image and version.

subcommands.name: list-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags associated with a Lambda MicroVM resource.

subcommands.name: resume-microvm
subcommands.description: Resumes a suspended MicroVM, restoring it to RUNNING state with all state intact.

subcommands.name: run-microvm
subcommands.description: Runs a new MicroVM from the specified image.

subcommands.name: suspend-microvm
subcommands.description: Suspends a running MicroVM, preserving its full memory and disk state.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to a Lambda MicroVM resource.

subcommands.name: terminate-microvm
subcommands.description: Terminates a MicroVM.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a Lambda MicroVM resource.

subcommands.name: update-microvm-image
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of a MicroVM image and triggers a new version build.

subcommands.name: update-microvm-image-version
subcommands.description: Updates the status of a specific MicroVM image version.
